newsitem.title: FINLAND: Strong H1 lifts Fiskars on weak Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Strong H1 lifts Fiskars on weak Helsinki.

text.p: Shares in Finnish consumer goods group Fiskars Oy rose on Monday, bucking a steep overall downtrend on its better than expected H1 results, brokers said.
At 1230/0930 GMT, the more liquid A-share traded at 500.00, up 5.00 markka or 1.01 percent and the K-share up 19.00 markka or 3.88 percent at 509.00, both in thin volume.
Fiskars posted H1 profit after financial items of 219 million markka compared to 139 million the same period last year. The top end of analysts' forecast was at 204 million.
"Had it been an uptrend day, it would have risen more," one broker said.
Only six other issues were higher in Helsinki while 76 were declining, and the FOX portfolio and derivatives benchmark was down 2.71 percent.
